# Mapletech Labs

> Mapletech Labs is a custom software, mobile app, AI and UI/UX development company, founded in 2018 in Edmonton by Raman Makkar, serving Edmonton, Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver and the rest of Canada.

## Company facts

- Name: Mapletech Labs
- Headquarters: Edmonton, AB T5J 1B9, Canada
- Phone: +1-403-604-8692
- Email: hello@mapletechlabs.ca
- Founded: 2018, in Edmonton
- Founder and CEO: [Raman Makkar](https://mapletechlabs.ca/about/raman-makkar)
- Website: https://mapletechlabs.ca
- About: https://mapletechlabs.ca/about
- All locations: https://mapletechlabs.ca/locations
- Full index (every service, service + city page and buyer guide): https://mapletechlabs.ca/llms-full.txt

## Services

- [Software Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services): custom software, web and mobile apps, AI and UI/UX for Canadian businesses.
- [Web Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/web-development): Next.js web apps, SaaS platforms, e-commerce systems, APIs and enterprise portals.
- [Mobile App Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native and cross-platform apps.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/ai-ml): LLM integration, AI automation, AI chatbots, computer vision and predictive analytics.
- [UI/UX Design](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/product-design): UI/UX strategy, wireframing, prototyping and design systems.
- [SaaS Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/saas-development): SaaS MVPs, multi-tenant architecture, billing and subscriptions, auth and SSO, analytics dashboards.
- [SEO & Digital Marketing](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/digital-marketing): SEO, Google Ads (PPC), social media marketing, content marketing and analytics.
- [Blockchain & Web3](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/blockchain-web3): smart contracts, DeFi protocols, NFT platforms, crypto wallets and Web3 dApps.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/cloud-devops): AWS architecture, Kubernetes and Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and performance scaling.
- [AR & VR Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/ar-vr): mobile AR, VR applications, WebXR experiences, Apple Vision Pro and industrial AR.
- [Game Development](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/game-development): mobile games, Unity and Unreal Engine titles, hyper-casual games and multiplayer LiveOps.
- [Branding & Identity](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/branding): brand strategy, logo and visual identity, brand guidelines, rebranding and motion branding.
- [WordPress & CMS](https://mapletechlabs.ca/services/wordpress-cms): custom WordPress themes, WooCommerce stores, headless WordPress, Strapi/Sanity CMS and site speed optimisation.
